title: Number of Good Ways to Split a String
summary: Given a string s, determine the count of ways to split it into two non-empty parts such that the number of unique characters in each part is identical.
statement: Given a string s, determine the count of ways to split it into two non-empty parts such that the number of unique characters in each part is identical.
constraints: Split s after any position that leaves two non-empty strings.
Count splits whose left and right sides contain the same number of distinct characters.
reference_solution:
def count_good_string_splits(s):
 right=Counter(s);left=set();answer=0
 for char in s[:-1]:
  left.add(char);right[char]-=1
  if right[char]==0:del right[char]
  answer+=len(left)==len(right)
 return answer

hints: Count all right-side character frequencies initially.
Move one character per split into a left-side set and decrement it on the right.
Delete a right key when its count reaches zero, then compare distinct counts.
The maintained structures exactly represent both non-empty sides at each possible split.

Only the middle split gives two distinct characters on each side.
